description: Agent Real Estate: submit an inspection report with the summary made from it: the report with its inspector, the day inspected and each finding with its id, system, severity (safety, major, moderate, minor or maintenance) and text; the summary with the day given, its text and each finding it names by report id with the severity it gives; each repair request with its id, the finding it answers, its status (requested, agreed, refused, credited or completed), the day completed and whether completion evidence is on record; and each re-inspection with the finding, the day and its result (resolved, partial or unresolved). The signed report gives the report with its findings by severity, the findings the summary names and leaves out, every finding given a lower severity than the report states, the wording in the summary that plays the report down, the repairs completed, unevidenced and contradicted, and the completed repairs with no re-inspection, and counts them, and names a softened summary: a major or safety finding missing from it, a major or safety finding given a lower severity, wording such as nothing major, only cosmetic or a clean inspection while the report records a major or safety finding, and a completed repair a re-inspection found unresolved; then a moderate finding left out or given a lower severity, a summary item or repair that names no finding in the report, a completed repair with no evidence and a completed repair to a major or safety finding with no re-inspection, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No findings, no summary items or text, a summary that names no findings by id, a finding with no severity, no repair record where the report holds a major or safety finding, or no re-inspection record for completed repairs leaves the summary unverified. This reads a property inspection against the claims made from it: wever_vendor-record-check reads a vendor report against the vendor record for risks that flatter the vendor, and wever_insurance-claims-deadline-check reads an incident against a policy’s deadlines, not what an inspection found. Verdict realty_inspection_softened, realty_inspection_partial, realty_inspection_unverified or realty_inspection_faithful. POST /api/realty-inspection-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

evidence.description: Whether completion evidence, such as an invoice or photo, is on record.

findings.description: Each finding as written in the report.

items.description: Each finding the summary names, by report finding id.
